subject: Invoice creation & collection ownership — decide email vs portal
messages:
From: Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@nimblehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Who creates invoice + delivery preference (PDF email vs portal)

Hi Naomi / Connor,

We're getting close to go-live for our pilot (PO 5189 attached to the contract). Finance flagged a quick operational question: who on Redwood creates the official invoice — the contract entity (Redwood, Inc.) or your billing sub-entity? Also, does Redwood send a PDF invoice directly to our AP inbox, or do you push invoices to a portal where we pull them?

A couple of constraints from our side:
- EU VAT ID on our PO (NL123456789B01) — we need the VAT to appear on the invoice.
- Our AP prefers emailed PDFs to ap@nimblehealth.com for smaller vendors; for high-volume vendors we use a portal.

Can you confirm your default flow and whether you can send the invoice to ap@nimblehealth.com? If you need a remit-to or entity form, let me know.

Thanks,
Tim Jenkins
Head of Finance — NimbleHealth

Attachments: PO_5189.pdf (PDF, referenced)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Who creates invoice + delivery preference (PDF email vs portal)

Hi Tim — great question, really glad you raised it now so we can lock the operational flow before invoices begin. Short answers up top:
- Redwood issues the invoice from the legal selling entity on the contract. If you need a specific remit-to entity we can accommodate (we have a billing child entity in the EU that we can use for VAT presentation).
- We support both delivery modes: emailed PDF (to an AP inbox) and our Billing Portal (SFTP / API options available too).

Notes and recommendation:
- For a single pilot with low monthly spend, emailed PDF to ap@nimblehealth.com is simplest and fastest.
- Portal delivery (we push to your portal or enable access) is recommended if you expect automated reconciliation or PO-match workflows.
- VAT: to make sure the VAT ID appears correctly, we need the exact legal name and VAT number as you want it printed on the invoice (company line). Please confirm the full remit-to name for the invoice.

Action items for us:
1) Connor will prepare a sample invoice (PDF) showing the EU VAT line and remit entity.
2) We'll confirm the Billing Portal configuration and whether we can push copies to your AP inbox in parallel for now.

Connor / Marissa: please pick this up — Connor, can you attach a draft invoice template and Marissa can confirm portal options and any HubSpot/ERP mapping notes.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Naomi’s signature: +1 415-555-0168 | naomi.feldman@redwood.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 13:00:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Who creates invoice + delivery preference (PDF email vs portal)

Hi Tim — attaching a quick draft so you can see how we surface VAT and remit-to. For this pilot I generated the invoice from our EU billing entity to ensure the VAT ID prints on the invoice line exactly as you supplied.

Draft highlights:
- Invoice number: RW-2028-000512 (placeholder)
- Billing entity: Redwood Inference EMEA B.V. (we can change if you require a different remit-to)
- VAT line: includes the VAT ID you provided (NL123456789B01)
- Delivery: we can email the PDF to ap@nimblehealth.com and also enable the Billing Portal; if you want AP to download from portal exclusively we can disable email copies once you confirm.

If email copies are fine to start, we'll send live invoices to ap@nimblehealth.com and add a portal feed two-way for reconciliation. Please reply with: (1) confirm remit-to name to print, (2) confirm email copy to ap@nimblehealth.com, (3) will you require a PO-match (3-way) in the portal?

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Billing Operations 
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_invoice_template_v2.pdf (PDF stub)
From: Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@nimblehealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@nimblehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 15:27:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Who creates invoice + delivery preference (PDF email vs portal)

Thanks — that looks good. Confirming:
1) Remit-to name on invoice: NimbleHealth B.V.
2) Please send email copies to ap@nimblehealth.com for the pilot (we'll move to portal-only if volume ramps).
3) We do NOT require 3-way PO-match in the portal for this pilot.

Also: can you include the PO number on the invoice line (PO: 5189)? That will help our AP reconcile quickly.

If you can push one live invoice after your systems are green, we'll confirm receipt and route for payment. 

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Tim
Head of Finance — NimbleHealth
